svg.title: From customer symptom to recovery proof
svg.desc: Six decision cards follow an incident from customer impact and bounded scope through matched evidence, competing explanations, a safe distinguishing check, a bounded response, and customer recovery with accepted-work reconciliation. The evidence-source table in the lesson supplies specific AWS tools. Harm may need containment before a cause is proven; an event or status label alone proves neither cause nor recovery.

g.text: From customer symptom to recovery proof
Follow the question; keep what you know separate from what you infer.
Who cannot do what, since when? Who coordinates?
Which account, Region, resource and time window?
Mark each fact observed, inferred or still unknown.
What result would rule out a likely cause?
Name target, owner, risk and reversal path.
Check fresh work and reconcile accepted requests.
Contain urgent harm sooner if needed; record the uncertainty.
An event or status label alone proves neither cause nor recovery.
